searchText: Made a troll side project blockchain on Google Sheets that might be interesting to folks here (also a good intro to blockchain 🙂) https://twitter.com/nibnalin/status/1442277619949453318 infura, alchemy, quicknode.. performance wise what is the fastest for rpc calls? I made a thing as a side project — Discord Lite where you're (automatically) in a channel for every NFT you own. I made it to familiarize myself with the web3 stack, which kind of feels like magic once you get it working: https://www.rarefied.is/# Good question. I would also like to know. Anyone here who benchmarked all 3? Looks like my question in <#672059911034634243> has been deleted 😕 any idea why and how i could get an answer to it instead? <@!624581815201562625> I'm not sure what your question was but assuming it is related to application development or support using some library or tool, the CrypoDevs discord is a good place. This server is strictly for discussion related to protocol development and explicitely not for "support". It was a question about the way gas fees are calculated If your question is related to something you are doing to improve or work on the Ethereum protocol, this can be an ok place to ask questions. Otherwise, you'll have to get it answered somewhere else.
